home.title: CS UI Components
home.headline: flet 1.0.0 · declarative component library
home.intro: Every component is rebuilt on @ft.component + hooks: declarative routing, root-view rendering and page overlays share one model. Switching language or theme only repaints subscribed components, so form state survives.

general.hint: Foundational text, button, icon, chip and image elements.

text.title: Text
text.hint: Header_1 to Header_5 map to the five Material heading levels; Quote and Link are common variants.
text.quote: A quote, lightly tinted by default
text.link: External link (opens in the system browser)

button.title: Button
button.hint: StyleType offers six semantic colors; plain renders an outlined button; ButtonShape controls the silhouette.

icon.title: Icon / Badge
icon.hint: Badge attaches a counter to a button; in 1.0.0 Tooltip is a control value, not a wrapper.
icon.rich_msg: This is how Tooltip works in flet 1.0.0

chip.title: Chip
chip.hint: Built on Label, supports single and multiple selection with an optional caption.

image.title: Image & Divider
image.hint: Image accepts fit and border_radius; Divider supports leading_indent.

markdown.title: Markdown & Json
markdown.hint: Markdown uses the GitHub extension set; Json wraps flet-code-editor and is read-only by default.

layout.hint: Layout primitives, lists and grids, expanders, timelines, tables and page scaffolding.

flex.title: Row / Column / Container / Stack
flex.hint: Layout primitives; Stack pins a red counter to the avatar's lower-right corner.

list.title: ListView / GridView
list.hint: Both support on-demand building, which keeps long lists cheap.

expander.title: Expander
expander.hint: The whole header is clickable and the chevron flips; variant offers card / filled / plain, density offers three steps.
expander.basic_sub: Click anywhere to expand or collapse
expander.basic_body1: This is the body of the expander.
expander.basic_body2: Any control can live in here.
expander.filled_sub: The icon drops into a tinted square
expander.filled_body: Pass an icon name to get the tinted square, or pass any control to use it as-is.
expander.plain_body: No border, ideal for grouped rows inside a list.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.hint: The axis sits on the left with timestamps in their own column; type sets the semantic color, done=True adds a check and a green dot.

table.title: Table
table.hint: Wraps DataTable with a pager, adds a row-number column and a hover tint.
table.name: Name

page.title: PageLayout
page.hint: Collapses title, subtitle, actions, padding and scrolling into one container.
page.content: The content area scrolls on its own

navigation.hint: Breadcrumbs, tabs, bottom and side navigation, plus a pager.

breadcrumb.title: BreadCrumb
breadcrumb.hint: items accepts a string, a (label, route) pair or a Crumb; clicks either navigate or run your callback.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.hint: Built from TabBar and TabBarView, with Tabs keeping them in sync.

navbar.title: NavigationBar / NavigationRail
navbar.hint: Bottom navigation for touch layouts, side rail for desktop; shown statically here.

paging.title: Paging
paging.hint: Driven by a PagingState object; long page ranges collapse into an ellipsis.

jump.title: Navigation
jump.hint: page.navigate(path) is the 1.0.0 entry point, equivalent to push_route.

form.hint: Form components follow the observable object + ui() pattern; instances are pinned with ft.use_ref, so parent repaints never drop their state.

input.title: Input
input.hint: data_type accepts str / int / float / file / dir; numeric inputs get +/- steppers.
input.name: Name

checkbox.title: Checkbox / CheckboxGroup
checkbox.hint: CheckboxGroup ships a select-all row and supports horizontal or vertical layout.
checkbox.agree: I have read and accept the terms

switch.title: Switch
switch.hint: on_change hands you a boolean; value is the current state.

radio.title: Radio
radio.hint: A radio group; pass strings to options and read the choice from value.

select.title: SelectBox / MultiSelect
select.hint: MultiSelect is a collapsed multi-choice field whose panel is mounted on the page overlay, so it takes no layout height.

slider.title: Slider / RangeSlider
slider.hint: min / max / divisions / slider_label behave like the native widget, wrapped in a Label layout.

rating.title: Rating
rating.hint: value counts from 1; set readonly for display-only use.

segmented.title: SegmentedButton
segmented.hint: Pass plain strings to options and they are wrapped into segments.

date.title: DateInput / DateTimeInput
date.hint: Click the field to open a floating panel; you can also type 2026-09-26 or 20260926. The date format follows the interface language.

color.title: ColorPicker
color.hint: A floating color panel: drag to set saturation and brightness, drag the hue strip on the right and the alpha strip below.

search.title: SearchBar
search.hint: options becomes the suggestion list; picking one fires on_click.

form.dump: Name={name} | Age={age} | City={city} | Tags={tags} | Volume={volume} | Rating={stars} | Birthday={birthday} | Meeting={meeting} | Brand={brand}

upload.hint: File components are observable objects too; value holds the final selection.

file.title: FilePicker
file.hint: allowed_extensions filters suffixes; allow_multiple switches between single and multi select.

dir.title: DirPicker
dir.hint: value is the absolute path, ready to feed into Input(data_type='dir').

save.title: FileSaver
save.hint: save_file(data) opens a save dialog and writes the payload to the chosen path.

image.title: ImagePicker
image.hint: Reuses the file mode of Input; value is the absolute path of the picked image.
image.label: Avatar

feedback.hint: Overlays go through page.show_dialog / page.pop_dialog; SnackBar and Toast are one-liners.

toast.title: Toast
toast.hint: Floats in, disappears on its own — ideal for operation receipts. toast_* are the shortcuts.

message.title: Message
message.hint: A standard SnackBar: bottom-anchored with a close button, for notifications that must be noticed.
message.body: This is a Message (SnackBar) with a close button, anchored to the bottom.

dialog.title: AlertDialog
dialog.hint: title / msg / style_type is enough; the action buttons take the semantic color.

progress.title: ProgressBar
progress.hint: value takes a float from 0 to 1; None renders an indeterminate bar.

hooks.title: State-driven UI (hooks)
hooks.hint: ft.use_state plus page.run_task: every progress change repaints the component.

display.hint: Logs, code, list tiles and an image gallery.

listtile.title: ListTile
listtile.hint: Pass strings directly, or controls for title / subtitle / leading / trailing.

log.title: LogContainer
log.hint: Colors by keyword: error red / warning amber / success green / info blue.
log.theme: warning: config is missing the theme field

code.title: CodeEditor / CodeView
code.hint: CodeEditor is editable (with autocomplete and issues); CodeView puts code and result side by side.

gallery.title: ImageGridView
gallery.hint: Ships with paging and a thumbnail-size slider; sources may be local files or URLs.

charts.hint: All four charts wrap flet_charts with Streamlit-style parameters (data / x / y), automatic colors and axes.

line.title: LineChart
line.hint: data accepts plain numbers, a list of dicts, a column dict or a list of tuples.

area.title: AreaChart
area.hint: opacity and gradient control the fill, curved controls smoothing.

bar.title: BarChart
bar.hint: stacked=True switches to stacked mode; rod_width sets the bar width.

scatter.title: ScatterChart
scatter.hint: radius sets the dot size — good for showing correlation.

media.hint: Media components backed by flet-audio / flet-video / flet-webview (sample assets come from the network).

audio.title: Audio / AudioPlayer
audio.hint: Audio is a page-level Service (no visuals, registered on construction); AudioPlayer is a card player.

video.title: Video
video.hint: Pass a single src, or a playlist; loop controls repetition.

pdf.title: Pdf
pdf.hint: Renders through an embedded WebView and accepts local paths or remote URLs.

about.hint: cs-ui · a Python UI library built on flet 1.0.0.

design.title: Design principles
design.hint: Four trade-offs: two paradigms, zero learning curve, one semantic palette, a shared core.
design.p1: • Two paradigms: stateless controls subclass native widgets, stateful ones use observable + ui()
design.p2: • Zero learning curve: every component is a flet control, so native arguments keep working
design.p3: • One semantic palette: StyleType is defined once, shared by buttons, dialogs and toasts
design.p4: • Shared core: chart colors live in chart/_data.py, field borders in core/styles.py

stats.title: Component count by category
stats.hint: Counted per subpackage under src/ui; demo helpers are excluded.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.hint: Framework and app strings share one registry; built-in labels and every date, number and calendar format come from the catalogs.
i18n.p1: • Three built-in catalogs: Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / English, falling back 繁 → 简 → 英
i18n.p2: • Built-in component text (pager, calendar, picker footers) is covered — no per-instance arguments needed
i18n.p3: • Dates, numbers, month and weekday names follow the language; English starts the week on Sunday
i18n.p4: • Switching language repaints only subscribers of use_t(), keeping page state and scroll position

migration.title: flet 1.0.0 migration cheatsheet
migration.hint: The APIs that changed most during the port. Two traps: page.render_views hides page overlays; ft.View cannot be used as a plain control in root-view mode.

run.title: Run the demo
run.hint: Two commands are enough: run it directly, or walk every route headlessly.
